tutorial.foundation: There are four foundations: two build down by suit from ♠Q, past A to K, and two build up by suit from ♦J, past K to A. Ranks wrap around, and all four foundations reaching 13 cards each (52 cards total) wins the game.
tutorial.tableau: Sixteen tableau slots, dealt **one card each** (the other 88 are the stock). Tableau cards can **only be sent to the foundations**, not built on the tableau. Empty slots are refilled **from the stock or waste**.
tutorial.emptyPile: When a pile empties it can be refilled **only from the stock or the waste**. A tableau card can never move into a gap, so an empty pile is not a tool for rearranging the board -- it is an outlet for the stock.
tutorial.stock: Turn the stock one card at a time onto the waste. **You can redeal up to three times.** When an empty slot is available, you can place straight from the stock without spending a turn on the waste.
tutorial.controls: Draw, hint, undo, auto-complete, and the other controls.
